The '''2026 Sandwell Metropolitan Borough Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026, alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] being held on the same day. All 72 members of [[Sandwell Metropolitan Borough Council]] were elected following ward boundary changes.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Bustin |first=Claire |title=The 2026 Local Elections |url=https://www.sandwell.gov.uk/election-results/2026-local-elections |access-date=2026-01-27 |website=Sandwell Council |language=en}}</ref> [[Reform UK|Reform UK]] gained control of the council for the first time, marking the end of almost 50 years of [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour]] control.

== Background ==
In [[2024 Sandwell Metropolitan Borough Council election|2024]], Labour retained control of the council.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Sandwell result - Local Elections 2024 |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/election/2024/england/councils/E08000028 |access-date=2026-01-27 |work=BBC News |language=en-GB}}</ref>
